g4-infra-001-b07.defect: G4-INFRA-001: B07 World/SaveGame/Narrative allocation-failure evidence depended on process-global allocation injection/sweeps.
g4-infra-001-b07.fix: B07-owned tests now use narrow deterministic module-local publication seams at World dynamic feature/transaction/restore publication, SaveGame restore pre-commit, Narrative restore publication, and NarrativeIntegration outbox publication. Shared fault helpers remain untouched.
g4-infra-001-b07.root_cause: The owned tests injected failures through process-global operator-new interception instead of deterministic module-private publication boundaries, so evidence could fail at unrelated allocations and was not narrow enough for Goal 4.

g4-narrint-001-revision-exhaustion.defect: G4-NARRINT-001: restored maximum outbox revision could wrap on the next mutating transition.
g4-narrint-001-revision-exhaustion.fix: NarrativeExternalConsequenceOutbox preflights a checked next revision for Execute, retry, acknowledge, terminal fail and prune; exhaustion returns failure before mutation.
g4-narrint-001-revision-exhaustion.root_cause: The persisted outbox revision was advanced by an unchecked increment. A valid restored UINT64_MAX revision therefore had no terminal exhaustion semantics and could wrap to zero.

g4-narrint-002-publication-atomicity.defect: G4-NARRINT-002: Execute advanced outbox revision before fallible durable delivery publication.
g4-narrint-002-publication-atomicity.fix: Execute stages the complete delivery, exercises a private pre-publication seam, publishes the delivery, then commits revision only after successful publication.
g4-narrint-002-publication-atomicity.root_cause: Execute committed revision metadata before the fallible vector publication of the durable delivery record, allowing allocation failure to leave false progress without durable work ownership.
